cases.name: Abigail Rose "Abby" Bieber
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Abby proudly served the District III community of Hillsborough County for four years as a Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Deputy. While Abby’s four year service as a Deputy was mostly concentrated on patrol, she also did special assignments in undercover work and at the Boys and Girls Club where she established many deep connections with the Boys and Girls Club children and staff even though her service there was brief. Additionally, Abby worked many off-duty shifts at Tampa Bay Downs where, once again, her infectious personality and enthusiasm made her many deep and abiding friendships. Abby was just recently approved by her command staff to begin an assignment in the HCSO Street Crimes unit. This transition likely would have led her to her “dream job” as a Detective in the Special Victims Section of the Criminal Investigations Division as a specialist in crimes against children. Abby was an avid runner and cherished her frequent visits to the Dunedin Causeway with her mother. She was also a great baker and enjoyed sharing her sweet treats with her family."

cases.name: Andrea Nicole Yarbrough
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Andrea's greatest joy was being a loving mother to her daughter ... and step-sons. She devoted herself wholeheartedly to their upbringing, nurturing their passions, and even participated in coaching their baseball teams.
Andrea was an avid sports enthusiast, with a deep-rooted loyalty to the St. Louis Cardinals, Florida Gators, and Jacksonville Jaguars. She shared her love for sports with her children and friends, often attending games and cheering passionately from the stands. Her love for the outdoors was evident in her frequent trips to the beach and her enthusiasm for outdoor activities shared with friends and family. Andrea's vibrant spirit extended to her enjoyment of concerts, where she could often be found singing along with the music she loved. Additionally, Andrea excelled in her career as a Financial Manager, where her dedication and expertise were admired by colleagues and clients alike at GraybaR. Her professionalism and ability to navigate complex financial landscapes earned her respect throughout her career. She was looking forward to starting her courses to obtain her Master’s degree.
Andrea will be remembered for her unwavering love for her family, her contagious laughter, and her desire to enjoy life. Her legacy of devotion and strength will live on in the hearts of all who were fortunate enough to have known her."
